title: Product page content (PDP)
purpose: Catalogue product page from a structured data sheet: short description, benefits, spec table, fit-check, policies, FAQ, meta and Product/Offer schema without invented facts.

grounding.rule: facts only from the data sheet or verified sources

search_intent_criteria: transactional: shopper can decide from the first screen
cta_policy: buy action belongs to the theme widget; copy supports it without urgency or invented discounts
link_policy: only supplied internal links; draft pages not linked; no competitor links
forbidden: invented specs, prices, stock, reviews, ratings, certifications, badges
human_review_triggers: health, supplement, cosmetic, child safety, electrical or food category

rubric.check: every spec and number traceable to the data sheet; gaps marked
answers the real purchase questions; fit-check; benefits tied to specs
manufacturer copy rewritten, no 8-word shared runs
no unproven superlatives, certifications or health claims; YMYL flagged
Product/Offer values visible and equal; no invented rating
native copy, units, currency, Persian rules
clean semantic HTML, alt on images, one H1

changes: New skill modelled on the landing/blog skills: data-sheet-first, no invented facts, schema mirrors page, QA with facts and source-text checks
